intent.raw: Persist the resolved stable-foundation choices and prepare a proposal-only two-lane route without implementation or subagents.
intent.objective: Refresh the remaining-meta-type plan for S1 and create a governed Define-to-Design-to-Plan route for the private stable CLI foundation, then join both plans without granting execution or release authority.
intent.operator_sentence: N1: freeze the decisions and prepare the proposal-only two-lane plan refresh.

technique_overlays.trigger: The existing RMT plan has a stale semantic denominator while the CLI target has no approved Define or Design baseline.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Each lane closes its own authoring lifecycle and the integration result proves shared P2/C2/S1 identity before any execution handoff.

technique_overlays.trigger: DomainSpec material is private and N1 authorizes planning artifacts only.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Only repository-relative private planning handles cross steps; no product, authority, public, Git, release, or external write is admitted.

subagent_strategy.trigger: P1 parallelism, synthesis, isolation, and context-protection triggers hold for two independent authoring lanes plus integration.
subagent_strategy.explanation: The problem shape would benefit from separate RMT-refresh, CLI-lifecycle, and integration roles, but the DomainSpec plan dispatch type is reserved and N1 forbids spawning. The roles below are descriptive only and cannot be registered or executed as a governed dispatch.
context: Lane A owns an existing Work Pack with a machine-valid but semantically stale S1 denominator.
Lane B has accepted decisions but lacks approved Define, Design selection, and Plan artifacts.
Both lanes must join on one private P2/C2/S1 and authority contract.
No product implementation, SWU selection, agent spawn, registration, or release effect is authorized.

roles.purpose: Author an exact proposal and staged refresh for the 22 S1-affected WP-RMT-002 planning targets.
Materialize the 21 choices through CLI-specific Define, Design selection, and Plan artifacts.
roles.owns: Lane B candidate planning root only

roles.purpose: Prove both plans share one P2/C2/S1 identity, preserve authority boundaries, and expose non-overlapping execution handoffs.
roles.capability_target: joined Lane A and Lane B planning receipts

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Do not confirm a subagent dispatch. If desired, separately approve inline planning authoring for Lane A and Lane B under their exact proposal-only write scopes.
receipt_requirements: Every authored lane result must name exact artifacts, validators, changed bytes, blockers, authority ceiling, and next owner.
Integration must consume passing Lane A and Lane B planning receipts and return pass, flag, or block without mutating either lane.
No result may claim implementation, profile admission, production stability, release, publication, or deployment.

steps.name: Select exact N1 evidence
stop_conditions: A selected source digest changes.
A required obligation lacks an exact source selector.
Protected/private material would cross into a public path.

steps.name: Validate descriptive route shape
stop_conditions: Dispatch Spec validation is not pass.
The route is treated as a register-dispatch sheet.
Subagent authorization is changed from blocked.

steps.name: Author the S1-bound RMT plan refresh
stop_conditions: Any current RMT plan target is edited without a separately approved exact material package.
RMT-OP-001 is selected or executed.
S1, the complete fault matrix, candidate-only authority, or historical receipt preservation is missing.
The proposed target inventory differs from the declared 22 paths.

steps.name: Define the CLI foundation from resolved choices
stop_conditions: A resolved SF-01 through SF-21 branch is silently changed.
The foundation is represented as the accepted 0.1.0 production product.
A product, profile, schema, lock, code, release, or authority target is mutated.

steps.name: Design the CLI foundation
stop_conditions: Define does not pass.
Any of the six design views is missing.
Design scope, denominator, owner binding, or two-pass selection validation does not pass.
Planned fixtures are treated as executed evidence.

steps.name: Plan the CLI foundation
stop_conditions: Design evidence state is not design-validator-pass.
Layering, implementation detail, SWU atomicity, closeout synchronization, validation strategy, or Plan Distill is incomplete.
The execution entry does not pass Implementation Readiness authoring validation.
Any implementation SWU is selected or executed.

steps.name: Validate cross-lane recomposition
convergence_criteria: Both plans bind the same decision digest, P2 profile identity, C2 causal denominator, S1 contract, and project-root topology.
Canonical, profile, implementation, evidence, Inventory, package, and release owners remain separate.
Execution write scopes are non-overlapping or have one explicit owner.
Historical receipt identity and all production/release claim ceilings are preserved.
stop_conditions: A shared contract differs between lanes.
An authority or write-scope overlap lacks one owner.
Either lane lacks a passing authoring receipt.
The integration result attempts to merge the Work Packs or repair a lane automatically.

steps.name: Request separate planning-only authorization
stop_conditions: The owner has not reviewed exact planning bytes and validator receipts.
The response is mistaken for subagent confirmation or implementation authorization.
Any acceptance-bound byte changed after validation.
Craft, profile, authority, release, or production state would change.

gates.condition: Every lane binds the exact accepted 2026-08-16 decision bytes and preserves the July product/profile decisions.
REFRESH-DISPATCH.json passes the repository-local Dispatch Spec validator as a descriptive private route.

gates.owner: Invoke Refresh and RMT plan owner
gates.condition: The exact 22-target staged plan refresh binds S1 and the complete fault matrix, passes Plan Distill and validators, and selects no SWU.
CLI-specific Define passes and Design reaches design-validator-pass with all six views and unchanged two-pass selection.
The medium/high complexity CLI Plan has complete layering, task details, atomic SWUs, closeout contracts, validation strategy, Distill pass, and a valid execution entry.
Lane receipts recompose under one P2/C2/S1 identity, non-overlapping owner boundaries, preserved history, and unchanged claim ceilings.
No plan dispatch sheet is registered, no check-tension run is claimed, and no subagent is spawned while dispatch_type plan remains reserved.
A later explicit approval binds exact planning authoring or exact staged plan bytes; it is separate from N1 and from implementation/release authorization.

No plan, receipt, candidate provider, generated view, Inventory entry, package, or review result grants profile, semantic, conformance, promotion, production, publication, release, or deployment authority.

observability.signal_grouping: Group future authoring evidence by dispatch_id and step_id; N1 emits no observability mutation outside this proposal package.

boundaries.contract: Pass repository-relative handles and bounded selectors only; never copy private DomainSpec prose into public arcanum or an external system.

boundaries.to_owner: current decision and refresh package only
boundaries.contract: N1 may write only the accepted decision record and this proposal package; every named plan/product/ledger/inventory/release target remains read-only.
Only separately owner-accepted exact Plan bytes with passing validators and execution-entry receipts may later reach Implementation Readiness; this route never selects or executes a unit.
Planning authoring, plan-byte apply, implementation selection, and release authorization are separate approvals and cannot be inferred from N1 or from the word confirmed.

authority.lifecycle: Invoke owns Define, Design, Plan, and Refresh authoring only.
authority.execution: Implementation Readiness and Task Session after separate exact authorization; none under N1.
authority.validation: Dispatch Spec, Design selection owners, Plan/Distill validators, and independent reviewers.
authority.evidence: Each source, plan, task, provider, and release-evidence owner retains its own receipt authority.
authority.memory: Inventory is a non-authority read model; no N1 Inventory mutation.
authority.promotion: DomainSpec-v2 Owners under existing authority and release gates; no promotion under this route.

state_namespaces.write_policy: Decision record and 2026-08-16 refresh package only.
Read-only under N1; later exact staged refresh and owner apply required.
Not created under N1; future planning-only authorization required.

state_namespaces.owner: respective DomainSpec, Craft, Inventory, and release owners

promotion_splits.target: profile, semantic, implementation-conformance, production, release, publication, or deployment state
promotion_splits.rule: Planning and review evidence can be referenced by the owning gate but never promotes itself.

promotion_splits.source: Inventory lookup or future strategy-result entry
promotion_splits.target: DomainSpec decisions, profile authority, or dispatch authorization
promotion_splits.rule: Inventory remains discovery-only and cannot replace direct sources, owner confirmation, or registration evidence.

promotion_guardrails: No implementation, SWU selection, profile/schema/authority mutation, Git, release, publication, deployment, or production effect.
No DomainSpec register-dispatch validation, check-tension claim, human dispatch confirmation, ledger append, spawn, or close row.
Changed decision or planning bytes require fresh evidence binding, validation, and owner review.
